generator: DevBridge DB-M02 Canonical Nexus Development Control Mapping
summary: Per-sheet governance contract: read obligations, relevance rules, write triggers, append/update behavior and validation rules. Backed by config/development-control-map.json. The Session Protocol sheet governs all other sheets and must never be overridden.

readWhen: Every task start (changelog narrative for current workbook version and recent governed changes)
Before any write to any other sheet (confirm version and current summary)
When assessing current control state or release decision
writeWhen: Workbook version increments after approved changes (update changelog narrative and Workbook version value)
Roadmap summary, control state, or release decision assessment materially changes
Only manual cells; formula cells are NEVER written
validation: Recompute manual counts from source sheets before writing
Prepend changelog entries, newest first; never delete narrative history
Never write formula cells (Current nodes, Milestones, Work items, Blocked nodes, per-phase counts)

readWhen: Every task (target node, ancestry, dependencies, status, acceptance criteria, evidence, next action)
Before any eligibility or preflight computation
Before any write that mirrors state elsewhere (Development Guide, Control Center)
writeWhen: Approved completion (Status, Current Evidence, Next Action, progress fields)
Governed fact/concept/status/ownership change (update current row AND append Version History record)
New node creation (append new row in the governed data range, below the last governed record; the formal Excel table boundary is not the governance boundary - DB-M02.1)
Node supersession (mark Status=Superseded; successor recorded)
validation: Node ID unique and RoadmapNode-formatted
Parent ID and Hierarchy Path consistent
Status from current-state vocabulary
No open Active Changes reservation on the node before writing
Progress honesty (blank rather than fabricated)

readWhen: Every preflight and task selection (all rows not Completed/Cancelled)
Before and during any implementation (reservation scope, branch/worktree, conflicts)
Before appending completion to a reservation row
writeWhen: Step 7: reserve change before editing (append new row with Change ID, Node ID, Worker, scope, timestamps, branch, worktree)
Step 8: scope change (update reservation BEFORE further editing)
Step 12/13: completion (update Status, Completed At, Result / Evidence; never delete row)
ADR / decision resolution (set ADR ID, Change Type, Validation Result)
validation: Change ID unique CHG-YYYYMMDD-NNN
Node ID / Affected Nodes resolve to RoadmapNode
Open reservation required before editing any node
Completed records remain; never delete history

readWhen: Selecting or verifying work (findings linked to target node or overlapping area/repository)
Preflight (a finding in scope is a constraint; resolution may be required)
writeWhen: Approved completion resolves a finding (Status, Verification, Owner)
New finding discovered (append after governance approval)
Due Gate or required action changes
validation: Finding ID unique AF-NNN
Roadmap Link resolves to RoadmapNode
Severity Critical/High/Medium; status transitions recorded

readWhen: Always. Before every task, preflight, execution, and completion.
validation: DevBridge must never modify the protocol
Every hard stop condition must halt DevBridge immediately

readWhen: Verifying current state (Is Current=Yes record matches Master Roadmap)
Tracing governed changes (Change ID, Record Version chains)
Before writing Master Roadmap (confirm no history would be overwritten)
writeWhen: Any governed fact/concept/status/ownership change (append newer Record Version with Change ID, reason, ADR/Decision link)
Concept changes even without code changes (Session Protocol rule)
End of chat (append records for everything governed)
validation: Node ID + Record Version unique
Exactly one Is Current=Yes per Node ID
Change ID / ADR link resolve when populated
Never update or delete existing rows

readWhen: Determining permitted execution sequence (current/non-superseded rows, Depends On chains, Exit Evidence)
writeWhen: Approved phase completion (Status=Completed, Exit Evidence)
New/revised phase approved (append or update; mark superseded rows Status=Superseded, never delete)
validation: Phase Step unique P<phase>-<step>
Depends On references existing Phase Step
Roadmap Link resolves to RoadmapNode
Only current/non-superseded rows are executable

readWhen: Every preflight where scope touches contracts/schema/layer ownership/architecture
Implementation planning (approved ADRs are authoritative constraints)
writeWhen: New architectural decision approved (append new ADR row with Change ID, Roadmap Links)
ADR superseded (mark old row Status=Superseded, link new ADR in Supersedes / Related)
validation: ADR ID unique ADR-NNN
Roadmap Links resolve to RoadmapNode
Contradiction with an approved ADR -> preflight verdict ARCHITECTURE CONFLICT

readWhen: Every task that touches a node referenced by an open decision
Preflight (unresolved decision that prevents safe implementation -> stop)
writeWhen: Task/discussion resolves a decision (Status=Decided, Resolution / ADR)
New unresolved decision discovered (append new DEC- row)
Corresponding ADR relationship recorded when a new ADR is created
validation: Decision ID unique DEC-NNN
Roadmap Links resolve to RoadmapNode
Decided rows reference their resolution ADR when applicable

readWhen: Every task eligibility and preflight computation (explicit graph is authoritative over textual Dependencies)
Resolving transitive closure of Open/Blocking relations
writeWhen: New dependency/blocker discovered during planning (append REL- row)
Dependency satisfied/resolved (Status=Satisfied/Resolved, Source Change noted)
validation: Relation ID unique REL-NNN
From Node / Depends On or Blocks resolve to RoadmapNode
Relation Type and Status from vocabulary
Graph is authoritative for eligibility

readWhen: Whenever a task involves external tools/services or integrations
Preflight for tool authorization (approval/safety requirements)
writeWhen: Tool/service approved or state changes (Current State, Approval / Safety, Notes)
Genuinely new tool/integration approved (append after governance approval)
validation: Tool / Service names unique
Never authorize an unlisted tool or one with unmet Approval / Safety requirements

readWhen: Verifying what actually happened (recent rows, Change ID / Session correlation)
Before accepting a completion (Human Review Status, Result, Evidence)
writeWhen: Every governed operation DevBridge performs (append Activity ID row with operation, entity, before/after, preflight verdict, result, evidence, duration, actor)
End of chat (Session Protocol rule)
validation: Activity ID unique ACT-YYYYMMDD-NNN
Timestamp UTC recorded
Change ID resolves when populated
New RowVersion recorded for governed writes
Never delete or update existing activity records

readWhen: Preparing task context (plain-English milestone planning)
Keeping milestone status/evidence/next step aligned with Master Roadmap
writeWhen: Milestone status/evidence/next step changes on Master Roadmap (mirror Status, Progress %, What Exists Now, Next Step)
New milestone created (append row)
validation: Milestone ID references an existing Milestone Node ID on Master Roadmap
Status/Progress/Next Step must not contradict Master Roadmap

readWhen: Generating task context (must instruct reuse of working assets rather than rebuild)
writeWhen: Implementation materially creates, replaces, or invalidates an existing-asset record (update row or append new Area after governance approval)
validation: Area unique
State from observed vocabulary
Task-context generation MUST include relevant Existing Assets rows
